nodes.name: release.sh
nodes.summary: Bash release automation script that bumps the semantic version, updates the backend/frontend package.json files and CHANGELOG.md, creates a git commit and tag, and optionally triggers a Docker image build via build.sh.

nodes.name: skills-lock.json
nodes.summary: Lockfile pinning the source and computed content hash of installed Claude Code agent skills (the Vercel best-practices skill set) used in this repository.

nodes.name: test-backend-config.sh
nodes.summary: Diagnostic shell script that verifies a TrueNAS/Docker deployment's frontend-to-backend wiring, checking container status, env vars, the nginx proxy configuration, and backend health-endpoint reachability.
